result.detailed_feedback:
**Element Layout (14.5 points):**
The split-screen layout effectively separates textual explanations from visual demonstrations. Spatial organization is clear, though some right-side animations could be larger for better impact.

**Attractiveness (12.5 points):**
The minimalist aesthetic and black-background color scheme provide a professional, distraction-free environment. Visual engagement is steady, though the graphic style remains relatively basic.

**Logic Flow (15.0 points):**
Pedagogical progression is excellent, moving from basic prerequisite definitions to complex 3D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D shifts. Transitions between concepts are smooth and logically sequenced.

**Accuracy & Depth (15.5 points):**
Content is scientifically accurate, particularly regarding unfolded nets and dimensional degrees of freedom. Depth is well-calibrated for an introductory look at dimensional geometry puzzles.

**Visual Consistency (14.0 points):**
Uniform typography and color-coding for different dimensions provide a cohesive experience. The integration between static text and moving geometric elements is maintained consistently throughout.

**Overall Summary:**
An effective instructional video that uses clear scaffolding to teach dimensional shifts. The presentation is professional and logically sound, though visually conservative.

**Key Strengths:**
• Logical pedagogical scaffolding
• Clear text-animation synchronization
• Accurate geometric representations

**Areas for Improvement:**
• Increase animation scale on right-side panel
• Incorporate more dynamic visual transitions
• Enhance aesthetic variety in summary graphics
